name: – § 7 – Am 16
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Clean Industrial Deal
part_text: 7.Endorses simplification and digitalisation to speed up permitting procedures, while respecting environmental safeguards and protecting human health; calls on the Commission to further address permitting bottlenecks for industrial access to energy and industrial decarbonisation in the Industrial Decarbonisation Accelerator Act, including through the adoption of measures to accelerate judicial and administrative procedures, and to assess criteria for targeted exemptions for construction emissions and depositions for clean and net zero projects, storage and grid projects; urges the Commission to radically simplify permitting standards and procedures, without creating new administrative layers or additional public budgets;
